grammar_title: 含 -ever 与 no matter 引导的让步状语从句(whatever/whoever/whichever/wherever/whenever/however)
source: 外研社版选择性必修第二册 Unit 6 Using language:adverbial clauses with -ever and no matter。句子地道、Survival 主题、答案唯一(干扰项为不合意的 -ever 词或不能引导该结构的 though/although)。

points.point: whatever / whoever / whichever(= no matter what/who/which,作让步状语)
points.overview: whatever(= no matter what)、whoever(= no matter who)、whichever(= no matter which)在让步状语从句里充当从句的主语、宾语或限定词;though/although 不能充当这些成分,故不可用。

points.point: wherever / whenever / however(+ adj./adv.,= no matter where/when/how)
points.overview: wherever(= no matter where)指地点、whenever(= no matter when)指时间;however 后接形容词或副词,意为 no matter how(不论多么……),不同于表示“但是”的 however。

points.point: -ever 让步状语 vs 名词性从句用法 · 与 no matter 互换
points.overview: whatever/whoever 既能引导让步状语从句(= no matter what/who),也能引导名词性从句作主语/宾语;两种情况 though/although 都不可用。no matter + what/who/where/when/how = 相应的 -ever 词。

questions.stem: "____ happens in the wild, a calm mind is your best tool for survival."
questions.explanation: 空作 happens 的主语、表“不论什么事”→ whatever(= no matter what);although 不能作主语。

questions.stem: "____ you find in the cave, do not eat it unless you are sure it is safe."
questions.explanation: 空作 find 的宾语、指物 → whatever;although 不能作宾语。

questions.stem: "____ leads the team into the jungle must carry a map and a kit."
questions.explanation: 空作 leads 的主语、指人 → whoever(= no matter who)。

questions.stem: "____ reaches the survivor first should keep him warm until help comes."
questions.explanation: 空作主语、指人 → whoever;although 不能作主语。

questions.stem: "____ path you choose down the mountain, watch out for loose rocks."
questions.explanation: 空限定 path、表“从若干条路里不论哪条”→ whichever(= no matter which)。

questions.stem: "____ tools you take to Mars, water and oxygen still matter most."
questions.explanation: 空限定 tools、指物 → whatever;though 不能作限定词。

questions.stem: "____ finds the underground ice first will solve the water problem."
questions.explanation: 空作主语、指人 → whoever。

questions.stem: "____ the storm destroys, the astronauts must rebuild it quickly."
questions.explanation: 空作 destroys 的宾语、指物 → whatever。

questions.stem: "____ shelter you build, make sure it blocks the deadly radiation."
questions.explanation: 空限定 shelter、指物 → whatever;although 不能加名词。

questions.stem: "____ of the two routes you take, tell someone where you are going."
questions.explanation: “of the two”表二者择一 → whichever(= no matter which)。

questions.stem: "____ you trust in a crisis, choose someone who stays calm."
questions.explanation: 空作 trust 的宾语、指人 → whoever。

questions.stem: "____ the doctors test, they hope to find a cure for the new disease."
questions.explanation: 空作 test 的宾语、指物 → whatever。

questions.stem: "____ wants to survive on the island must learn to be patient."
questions.explanation: 空作 wants 的主语、指人 → whoever。

questions.stem: "____ the firefighters do next, they must not let the blaze spread."
questions.explanation: 空作 do 的宾语、指物/事 → whatever。

questions.stem: "____ medicine the scientists try, the struggle against the virus goes on."
questions.explanation: 空限定 medicine、指物 → whatever。

questions.stem: "____ of you has the first-aid kit should treat the wound right away."
questions.explanation: “of you”表从你们之中择一 → whichever。

questions.stem: "____ the rising sea takes from the island, the people will not give up."
questions.explanation: 空作 takes 的宾语、指物 → whatever。

questions.stem: "____ joins the rescue mission needs courage and a clear head."
questions.explanation: 空作 joins 的主语、指人 → whoever。

questions.stem: "____ animal moves into the city, it is only trying to survive."
questions.explanation: 空限定 animal、指物 → whatever。

questions.stem: "____ you decide to do, never panic when a wildfire breaks out."
questions.explanation: 空作 do 的宾语、指物/事 → whatever。

questions.stem: "____ they go, urban animals find towns and cities in their way."
questions.explanation: 表“不论去到哪里”、地点 → wherever(= no matter where)。

questions.stem: "____ hard the two-year treatment was, Jane never gave up hope."
questions.explanation: 空后接形容词 hard、意为 no matter how → however;although 不直接加形容词。

questions.stem: "____ a wildfire breaks out, leave the area quickly but calmly."
questions.explanation: 表“每当、不论何时”、时间 → whenever(= no matter when)。

questions.stem: "____ you go in the wild, take a first-aid kit with you."
questions.explanation: 表“去野外的任何地方”、地点 → wherever。

questions.stem: "____ fast the birds fly, some still crash into the glass towers."
questions.explanation: 空后接副词 fast、意为 no matter how → however。

questions.stem: "____ the temperature rises above forty degrees, people are warned to stay indoors."
questions.explanation: 表“每当气温升到……时”、时间 → whenever。

questions.stem: "____ foxes settle in the city, they soon learn to find food."
questions.explanation: 表“在城里安家的任何地方”、地点 → wherever。

questions.stem: "____ dangerous the journey to Mars may be, scientists still dream of it."
questions.explanation: 空后接形容词 dangerous、意为 no matter how → however。

questions.stem: "____ the rescue team arrives, the survivor must keep himself warm until then."
questions.explanation: 表“不论何时到达”、时间 → whenever。

questions.stem: "____ humans build their cities, wild animals try to live alongside them."
questions.explanation: 表“在人类建城的任何地方”、地点 → wherever。

questions.stem: "____ carefully you plan, survival in the wild can still be hard."
questions.explanation: 空后接副词 carefully、意为 no matter how → however。

questions.stem: "____ the heat wave returns, swimming pools fill with people cooling down."
questions.explanation: 表“每当热浪重来时”、时间 → whenever。

questions.stem: "____ the astronaut looks on Mars, he sees only red, empty land."
questions.explanation: 表“朝任何地方看”、地点 → wherever。

questions.stem: "____ tired she felt, Jane kept inviting people to donate tissue samples."
questions.explanation: 空后接形容词 tired、意为 no matter how → however。

questions.stem: "____ a crisis appears, calm people look for a solution instead of panicking."
questions.explanation: 表“每当危机出现时”、时间 → whenever。

questions.stem: "____ you camp for the night, choose a spot far from wild animals."
questions.explanation: 表“在你过夜的任何地方”、地点 → wherever。

questions.stem: "____ deep the snow became, the climbers pushed on towards the shelter."
questions.explanation: 空后接形容词 deep、意为 no matter how → however。

questions.stem: "____ the river floods, the village quickly moves to higher ground."
questions.explanation: 表“每当河水泛滥时”、时间 → whenever。

questions.stem: "____ the survivor travels on the island, he marks the path behind him."
questions.explanation: 表“在岛上去到的任何地方”、地点 → wherever。

questions.stem: "____ slowly the rescue comes, hope keeps the lost hiker going."
questions.explanation: 空后接副词 slowly、意为 no matter how → however。

questions.stem: "You may take ____ you need from the emergency box before you leave."
questions.explanation: 引导名词性从句作 take 的宾语、指物 → whatever;although 不能引导名词性从句。

questions.stem: "____ reaches the lifeboat first should help the weaker passengers aboard."
questions.explanation: 引导名词性从句作主语、指人 → whoever。

questions.stem: "____ the reasons behind the animals entering our cities, survival comes first."
questions.explanation: 让步状语(= no matter what)、后接名词 the reasons → whatever;although 不能直接加名词。

questions.stem: "Robinson Crusoe made good use of ____ he could save from the wrecked ship."
questions.explanation: 引导名词性从句作介词 of 的宾语、指物 → whatever。

questions.stem: "No matter ____ happens, a calm survivor keeps looking for a way out."
questions.explanation: no matter what = whatever、空作 happens 的主语、指物 → what。

questions.stem: "The rescue team will help ____ is still trapped under the fallen rocks."
questions.explanation: 引导名词性从句作 help 的宾语、指人 → whoever。

questions.stem: "No matter ____ hard the climb is, the team refuses to turn back."
questions.explanation: no matter how + 形容词 hard = however hard → how。

questions.stem: "Share the clean water with ____ needs it most in the group."
questions.explanation: 引导名词性从句作介词 with 的宾语、指人作 needs 的主语 → whoever。

questions.stem: "____ the storm leaves behind, the islanders will rebuild their homes."
questions.explanation: 让步状语、空作 leaves 的宾语、指物 → whatever。

questions.stem: "No matter ____ you go on the island, hunger will find you in the end."
questions.explanation: no matter where = wherever、表地点 → where。

questions.stem: "The doctors will test ____ medicine might cure the new disease."
questions.explanation: 引导名词性从句、限定 medicine 作 test 的宾语 → whatever。

questions.stem: "____ you meet in the wild, treat them with respect and caution."
questions.explanation: 让步状语、空作 meet 的宾语、指人 → whoever。

questions.stem: "No matter ____ leads the team, the group must stay together."
questions.explanation: no matter who = whoever、指人作 leads 的主语 → who。

questions.stem: "Eat ____ the land can safely give you, and waste nothing."
questions.explanation: 引导名词性从句作 eat 的宾语、指物 → whatever。

questions.stem: "____ the future may hold, Jane is determined to live a full life."
questions.explanation: 让步状语(= no matter what)、空作 hold 的宾语 → whatever。

questions.stem: "Give the warm blanket to ____ feels the cold the most."
questions.explanation: 引导名词性从句作介词 to 的宾语、指人作 feels 的主语 → whoever。

questions.stem: "No matter ____ the rescue arrives, we must keep the fire burning as a signal."
questions.explanation: no matter when = whenever、表时间 → when。

questions.stem: "Tell ____ you can reach that the path down the mountain is blocked."
questions.explanation: 引导名词性从句作 tell 的间接宾语、指人 → whoever。

questions.stem: "____ difficulties she might face, Jane keeps helping other patients recover."
questions.explanation: 让步状语、限定 difficulties → whatever;although 不能直接加名词。

questions.stem: "Use ____ tools you have to dig the cave deeper before night falls."
questions.explanation: 引导名词性从句、限定 tools 作 use 的宾语 → whatever。
